data.headline: Shaping the State of Private AI for Regulated Industries using Local Right-Cloud Infrastructure for Sovereign AI Mandates
data.about:
- A high-impact, customer-centric, growth-focused "servant leader" - with strategic insights, forward-thinking leadership, and deep experience in AI, Data & Analytics - who thrives at (1) the intersection of product, platform, and profit and knows how to turn market insights into platform growth strategies and (2) connecting business objectives to technology-enabled solutions

- A product and technology strategist with 25+ years of driving innovation - with exceptional market and business acumen - at the intersection of digital transformation (in several sectors)

- A thought leader, educator, and advocate for next-gen infrastructure - with deep understanding of AI (i.e., Hybrid AI, Edge AI, and Enterprise AI) (inclusive of Generative AI), enterprise architecture, ecosystem partnerships, and go-to-market (GTM) strategy and execution (inclusive of startups and growth-stage companies)

- A player-coach who excels at bridging strategy and execution, building high-performing teams, and delivering measurable customer value through technology-driven business solutions

- A Sovereign Edge Futurist, an AI-Ready Edge Champion, a Decentralized Cloud Advocate, an Edge Sovereignty Visionary, and an On-Premise Private Edge Cloud Missionary
____________________________________________________________
Specialties

- Building and commercializing new products, solutions, and services
- Understanding product-market fit for emerging technologies and platforms
- Building complex and curated partner ecosystems
- Scaling go-to-market (GTM) strategy for products, platforms, solutions, and services
- Managing cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Business Development, Partnerships, Marketing and Sales
____________________________________________________________
Areas of Interest

1. Sovereign AI (i.e., Private AI = Edge AI in On-premise Private Edge Cloud)
2. GenAI (with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)), LLMs, and Domain-Specific SLMs (for both Public GenAI and Private GenAI)
3. Multimodal AI Agents
4. Agentic AI with Multimodal Models
5. Real-Time Reasoning (in the context of Agentic AI)
6. Edge (Cloud) Computing (in the context of IoT)
7. Advanced Analytics
8. Neoclouds and Hybrid Clouds
9. Robotics and robotic systems (inclusive of AMRs and AGVs)
10. Vision Systems (i.e., Computer Vision, Machine Vision, and Robot Vision)

experiences.title: Global CTO, Regulated Industries (Life Sciences and Financial Services)
experiences.subtitle: Lenovo . Full-time
experiences.caption: Oct 2025 - Present · 3 mos

description.text:
Enable Regulated Industries (HLS (Healthcare & Life Sciences) and BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance)) to Scale AI (Artificial Intelligence) from Experimentation to Production

Accelerate enterprise adoption of "Private AI" Clouds - dedicated, isolated environments to keep AI models, data, and compute securely under the organization's control

Address critical requirements around data sovereignty, cost predictability, and regulatory compliance (including HIPAA, FINRA, and GDPR)

Deliver industry-specific AI and HPC (High-Performance Computing) solutions that solve high-value business challenges and accelerate innovation

Develop compelling, outcome-driven offerings that enable organizations to deploy trusted, secure, and compliant AI at scale

subComponents.title: Global Head of Ecosystem Partnerships - Data, AI, and Analytics
subComponents.caption: May 2018 - Sep 2025 · 7 yrs 4 mos

description.text:
- Architect global partner strategy for Data, AI*, and Analytics** - for technology and GTM partners
- Design and execute scalable, outcome-driven partner strategies to accelerate adoption of AI and IoT use cases across diverse industries
- Engage and collaborate with a broad partner ecosystem - ranging from global ISVs, Technology Providers, CSPs (Azure, AWS, GCP), OEMs/OESs, GSIs/RSIs, Distribution Partners, ASPs/MSPs/VSPs, and VARs to emerging innovative AI startups - fostering innovation and joint value creation
- Provide thought-leadership on how AI reshapes partner business models, unlocking new revenue streams and solution opportunities
- Lead solution GTM (industry-specific use-cases) and commercial GTM (co-sell, resale, OEM, and co-development models) across key verticals: Industrial & Manufacturing, Retail & Hospitality, Energy & Utilities (E&U), Oil & Gas (O&G), Healthcare & Life Sciences (HLS), Communications, Media & Entertainment (CME), Transportation & Logistics (T&L), Construction & Mining, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI), and Government (Federal, State, and Local)
- Shape GTM strategies with direct sales and indirect (channel partner) sales teams, driving customer success through "sell-with" and "sell-through" motions, as applicable
- Enable partners to envision, develop, and deploy high-impact AI solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes
- Align partner needs with product strategy, roadmaps, and engineering priorities - bridging GTM with R&D
- Operationalize partner success through structured programs for onboarding, technical enablement, certification, and investment/funding
- Influence partner-ready content, sales plays, training assets, and field GTM kits
- Represent at key industry events and partner engagements
____________________________________________________________
* AI = AI/ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI
** Analytics = Descriptive, Prescriptive, and Predictive (inclusive of IoT Analytics)

subComponents.title: Global Head of Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy - Data, AI, and Analytics
subComponents.caption: Jun 2018 - Jan 2023 · 4 yrs 7 mos

description.text:
- Spearheaded industry GTM strategy driving revenue growth - across direct sales and partner sales
- Designed and operationalized outcome-driven solutions for multiple sectors: Industrial & Manufacturing, Retail & Hospitality, E&U, O&G, HLS, CME, T&L, Construction & Mining, BFSI, and Government (Federal, State, Local)
- Defined and executed strategic initiatives in close collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders - sales, marketing, product and solution management, engineering - to ensure alignment and impact
- Predicted and spotted market-shaping trends early; led organizational transformation efforts through white-space analysis, value chain mapping, business model innovation, and competitive intelligence (CI)
- Identified key macro and microeconomic drivers within core verticals; developed compelling narratives and strategic messaging to enable executive decision-making and end-user engagement
- Led both strategic and tactical market development initiatives - uncovering growth opportunities, shaping client relationships, scoping high-value engagements, and crafting differentiated value propositions
- Utilized strong executive presence to influence senior stakeholders and deliver business outcomes for complex, high-impact customer opportunities

NOTE: GTM includes cross-functional collaborations across sales and presales, channel strategy and management, product marketing, product management, customer success, partnerships and alliances, as well as supporting functions such as revenue operations

description.text:
- Crafted compelling messaging and differentiated positioning for the SAS Viya 4 Analytics for IoT platform, articulating its unique value proposition in the competitive AIoT (AI-embedded IoT Analytics) landscape
- Identified a set of curated high-impact AIoT use cases to showcase real-world applications of SAS AIoT capabilities
- Developed and owned the SAS Streaming Analytics Value Proposition (VP) - in alignment to SAS (Mercury) corporate governance and approval process to support GTM and sales readiness efforts
- Collaborated closely with the SAS corporate marketing team to create industry-specific product marketing assets - including product collaterals, solution briefs, use case brochures, presentations, videos, and web content
- Partnered with creative teams to deliver visually compelling, brand-aligned collateral that effectively communicated AIoT solutions value to diverse audiences (user personas)
- Worked with other global product marketing team members to design, launch and support integrated campaigns that increased market awareness and generated qualified pipeline

- Accelerated HPE's entry into the IoT and M2M market with a platform approach to support a multi-vertical and a multi-network strategy
- Drove cross-domain solution GTM for Americas region; collaborated with EMEA and ASPAC regions to cross-pollinate customer use cases and deployment experiences
- Positioned Carrier-Grade and Enterprise-Grade "HPE Universal IoT Platform" to support Industrial IoT (IIoT) and Consumer IoT Service Providers across several sectors: (1) Transportation & Automotive (Connected Cars and Commercial Fleet Management), (2) Smart Cities - Smart Buildings, Smart Metering, Smart Parking, Smart Street Lighting), (3) Precision Agriculture, (4) Industrial and Manufacturing, and (5) Oil & Gas
- Influenced discussions with early clients (MVP v1.0) in to nurture and mature the offerings 
- Developed high-value use cases to help Carriers and Enterprises to generate new revenues

Sample customers: AT&T, AT&T Mexico (Iusacell & Nextel), Verizon, America Movil, Telcel Mexico, Orange France, O2
